name: The Creator and the Creature, or the Wonders of Divine Love
name_pt: O Criador e a Criatura, ou as Maravilhas do Amor Divino
author: Fr. Frederick William Faber
desc: Faber's treatise of 1857 on God's creative love, in three books: the case stated between the Creator and the creature, the difficulties of creative love, and objections considered. It sets out why God made us, what He asks in return, and the answer to the hesitations of souls who find the love of God hard to grasp.
desc_pt: O tratado de Faber (1857) sobre o amor criador de Deus, em três livros: a questão posta entre o Criador e a criatura, as dificuldades do amor criador e as objeções examinadas. Mostra por que Deus nos fez, o que pede em troca e responde às hesitações das almas que acham difícil compreender o amor de Deus.
editor: Fr. Frederick William Faber (American edition, Baltimore: Murphy, 1857)
edition: The Creator and the Creature, or the Wonders of Divine Love (American edition, 1857), University of Toronto scan, Internet Archive full-text OCR.
srcnote: The author's preface is kept; the American publisher's introduction, the analytic table of contents and the index are dropped.
